question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

Mayra has the __ability __for mathematics.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ability"** means the possession of the means or skill to do something. (क्षमता)

 
 
• **Example: **She has the** ability** to solve complex problems quickly.
 
 
 
• **"Aptitude"** refers to a natural ability to do something or a natural talent. (स्वाभाविक योग्यता)
 
 
• **Example: **He has a remarkable **aptitude** for learning new languages.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Astute** (चतुर): Having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations or people and turn this to one's advantage.

 
 
• **Example:** He is an astute businessman who always finds the best deals.
 
 
 
• **Altitude** (ऊंचाई): The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.
 
 
• **Example:** The airplane was flying at a high altitude.
 
 
 
• **Attitude** (रवैया): A settled way of thinking or feeling about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a positive attitude towards her work.
